newsitem.title: INDIA: Times of India workers may go on strike again.
newsitem.headline: Times of India workers may go on strike again.

text.p: The workers union of the Times of India's Delhi edition, which called a strike on Friday, has threatened to take industrial action every Saturday if their demands are not met, officials said.
"They have threatened to go on strike on every Saturday if their demands are not met," a senior editor of the Times of India Group, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
There was no Delhi edition of the Times of India on Saturday.
The Times, with seven nationwide editions, has a daily circulation of about 850 to 900,000 copies, a circulation department official said. On Sunday, the Times of India just over one million copies.
Workers on Friday were protesting against what they called inadequate bonus payments and alleged retrenchment moves.
